ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant high-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible fluke; low-intensity (black) pixels are restricted to the perimeter and peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white field across central lobes; dark pigment banding concentrated at the trailing edge and lower peduncle; single dark focal spot (roughly circular) on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with clear vertex definition; estimated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex sweep trajectory toward the distal tips, creating a symmetrical fan-shaped profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle encrustations on distal tips; vertical dark pigmentation streaks extending from the peduncle into the white field; minor yellowish-pink pixel tint near the central notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct singular dark circular spot on the left lobe pigmentation field.
